articles.summary: As a company operating in a highly regulated industry, Elbit America has long understood that a strong ethics and compliance program is non-negotiable. Several years into its partnership with Ethisphere, the organization now sees that commitment not just as a safeguard, but as a strategic advantage that reinforces integrity, governance, and stakeholder trust.
articles.title: Strengthening Elbit America's Ethics & Compliance Program with Ethisphere

articles.summary: Elbit America is participating in the 2026 Future Indirect Fires Summit and showcasing SIGMA. SIGMA is the company's mobile tactical cannon that is mature, production-ready and aligned with the U.S. Army’s needs.
articles.title: Leading the conversation on Future Indirect Fires

articles.summary: Elbit America received a delivery order valued at approximately $74.4 million for Squad Binocular Night Vision Goggle (SBNVG) systems from Marine Corps Systems Command. The SBNVG systems will be produced at the company’s facility in Roanoke, Virginia through 2027. The delivery order was placed under a multi-year Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (ID/IQ) contract valued at roughly $500 million secured in 2023.
articles.title: Elbit America To Continue Delivering Night Vision Systems To USMC Through 2027

articles.summary: Elbit America image intensification tubes can be trusted as superior as they’re currently evaluated under criteria developed by the U.S. Army. Our Gen 3 image intensifier technology gives warfighters the ability to move, decide, and act with confidence – whether under open skies, dense foliage, or operating in extreme low-light conditions, which leave no room for compromise.
articles.title: Seeing the Battlefield as It Truly Is: The Gen 3 Advantage Offered by Elbit America’s Trusted Image Intensification Tubes
